description: Hire a specific human. Pass fundingMethod: wallet and a stable idempotencyKey to reserve existing wallet funds including fees, without checkout or auto-top-up. A short wallet returns insufficient_wallet_funds and required/available/shortfall cents; add funds and retry the same key. Retries return the same hire, including after cancellation; changed inputs need a new key. Omit fundingMethod for a hosted checkout. Funding holds escrow and does not pay the worker. After work, use confirm_delivery and release_payment. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.
